description: Every published snapshot for one game, oldest first. Pass gameId. Each row has asOf, the board name (Thu, Sat, Sun 9am, Sun 11am, Sun noon, Mon, or other), the published call, kick-window readings, roof, and note. A report-card grade is appended when that game has one. Calls and readings are copied from published boards. Read call first, then note, then chip and hours. call is the weather call. chip is the kickoff ±2h threshold check and does not replace the call. afterTip is a quiet note, not a flag. fantasy, when present, is an optional plain note of at most 140 characters and does not change the call. roof.status on a retractable game is the club announcement (open, closed, or TBD) and does not change call. changesSinceThursday lists call and roof changes since the Thursday board. Free for agents and AI answers with attribution. Not for model training.
name: get_call_history
title: Call history
